subject.title: Model Setup 'Test & use' fails on configless gateways: prepared model runtime owner was not committed after replacement

question: Should the prepared-runtime lifecycle owner contract treat the existing configless provider-derived owner as a valid committed activation target, or should Model Setup create and commit an explicit configured owner before activation?
rationale: Both paths can resolve the immediate failure, but the durable ownership boundary affects lifecycle semantics established by the merged refactor and needs the area owner’s intent.

options.title: Preserve configless owner identity
options.body: Allow activation to commit or rebind the current configless prepared owner when it is the runtime selected by provider-env discovery, while retaining configured-owner replacement rules elsewhere.

options.title: Materialize configured ownership
options.body: Make Model Setup persist and publish an explicit configured owner before activation, accepting the resulting configuration and upgrade semantics.

recommendation.title: Preserve configless owner identity
recommendation.body: Allow activation to commit or rebind the current configless prepared owner when it is the runtime selected by provider-env discovery, while retaining configured-owner replacement rules elsewhere.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged prepared-runtime lifecycle and configless reuse work provide the clearest ownership history for choosing the intended invariant.
